purpose: Teach: フルタイム/所以/独禁法/両氏/所収/インタラクティブ/送受信/キャッチフレーズ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、フルタイム社員の働き方改革を進めろ
lines.en: I want our company to move forward with work-style reform for full-time employees.
lines.style: Measured, executive tone. Clear enunciation on directives. Slight pause between clauses—thinking strategically. No inflection; authority rests in the words themselves.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。我が社が信頼される所以を見つめ直します
lines.en: Yes. I'll take another look at what makes our company trustworthy.
lines.style: Respectful, focused intake. Slight breath before committing to the action. Steady, not rushed. The tone of someone taking careful notes—internally aligning with the directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、独禁法違反のリスクを徹底回避しろ
lines.en: Our company needs to thoroughly avoid antitrust law violations.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Weight on 'thoroughly'—this is non-negotiable. Direct eye contact implied. The cadence of someone who has thought about risk before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新旧社長両氏の対談企画を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare an interview featuring both the outgoing and incoming presidents.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Slight raise in energy—this is a concrete, actionable step. Professional but not stiff. The tone of someone translating abstract concern into tangible work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社史所収の論考を改めて読め
lines.en: Read the essays in our company history again—carefully.
lines.style: Deliberately paced. Light emphasis on 'again'—there's something in there worth remembering. Quiet insistence. The manner of someone pointing back to a principle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インタラクティブなウェブサイトに改修します
lines.en: Yes. I'll redesign our website to make it more interactive.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Small breath after 'yes'—showing he's absorbed the task. Professional, forward-moving tone. No hesitation; competence in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内文書の送受信を電子化しろ
lines.en: Our company will digitize all internal document transmission and receipt.
lines.style: Formal, structural. Slight pause between 'transmission' and 'receipt'—this is systematic. The tone of operational efficiency. No warmth; this is infrastructure, not negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品のキャッチフレーズを公募します
lines.en: Yes. I'll open a public call for catchphrases for the new product line.
lines.style: Final confirmation—the meeting's closing note. Slightly lighter energy than previous responses. Still professional, but the cadence softens slightly; the work is now distributed and moving forward.
